# Great Learning

> > India's largest online learning platform offering university-partnered postgraduate programs and professional certifications in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, and emerging technologies.

Great Learning provides comprehensive online education through partnerships with leading universities including MIT, University of Texas at Austin, Johns Hopkins, and IIT. The platform specializes in career-focused professional development with hands-on projects, mentorship, and industry-recognized certifications.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Artificial Intelligence
- University of Texas at Austin (UT Austin)
- MIT Professional Education
- Postgraduate Programs
- Professional Certifications
- Cloud Computing
- Cybersecurity
- Python
- Prompt Engineering
- Career Development
- Hands-on Projects
- Mentorship

## Flagship Postgraduate Programs

- [Data Science & Generative AI Online PG Certificate Course by UT Austin](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/pg-program-data-science-business-analytics-course): PGP Data Science & Analytics with Generative AI by UT Austin McCombs
- [AI & Machine Learning Certificate Program Online by UT Austin](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/pg-program-online-artificial-intelligence-machine-learning): PGP AI & Machine Learning with Generative AI and agentic AI by UT Austin
- [MIT Applied Data Science & AI Certificate Course Online](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/mit-data-science-program): Applied Data Science & AI certificate program from MIT Professional Education
- [MIT IDSS AI and Data Science Course Online with ML](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/mit-data-science-and-machine-learning-program): MIT IDSS AI and Data Science with machine learning and generative AI
- [AI for Business Leaders & Managers Post Graduate Program](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/ai-for-leaders-course): AI for Leaders postgraduate program for business managers by UT Austin
